name: minstrel_sw_walk_v01
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve hand-painted miniature game animation. Preserve the supplied compact2.7-head NPC's EXACT skull/face/hair crown size, FRONT-LEFT diagonal viewpoint, neck/chest/waist proportions, costume and props. Same upright head and body scale in all FOUR frames. Long silver-white hair with faint lavender shadows, a thick side braid draped over anatomical RIGHT shoulder, soft bangs and a small burgundy ribbon at back, violet-gray eyes, human round ears. Ivory puff-sleeve blouse, navy-blue asymmetrical layered skirt with ivory underskirt and restrained gold star/constellation embroidery, brown fitted waist corset/belt with small tassels and ONE brown satchel on anatomical LEFT hip, brown ankle boots. ONE burgundy scarf wrapped around neck with two fringed tails draping back. ONE silver transverse flute held low horizontally at waist with both hands in neutral standing, never a sword/staff. Preserve musician identity, braid placement and ivory/navy/burgundy/silver palette from portrait. Make FOUR consecutive slow walk poses traveling LOWER-LEFT, in2x2 reading order. Keep the entire original head, shoulders, chest, waist and carried props rigid and unchanged; animate only legs, lower cloth and a restrained free arm. 1 FOREGROUND NEAR leg reaches lower-left heel-contact, FAR leg trails upper-right toe;2 near leg supports under pelvis, FAR knee/boot swings forward;3 OPPOSITE contact: FAR leg now reaches lower-left, foreground NEAR leg trails upper-right with raised heel, near shin overlaps in front at crossing;4 FAR leg supports under pelvis, NEAR knee/boot swings forward. Clearly exchange which leg leads in frame3: not four same-leg lunges or two repeated poses. Keep equal pelvis height, original leg/boot lengths, no head bob/nod/turn or body compression. If both hands carry a prop, keep both hands exactly in the original carrying pose; never add an arm swing third hand. No raising shawl/skirt unnecessarily. Four COMPLETE separate figures inside equal2x2 cells,10% empty margin for full hair/cape/boots and props, no cropping or overlap. True transparent RGBA, nonpixel broad soft shading, no labels/grid/FX/shadow/floor/background gradient.
manual_review: Whole-body review: foreground leg leads in both contact phases; carpenter additionally touches source top. Do not admit.

review_history.reason: Earlier sheet review: contact poses repeat the same leading leg; technical head registration alone is insufficient.
